parameters.content:
## Meta Ads Advertiser Leak Audit, Tech Stack X-Ray & Weekly Watch-Diff Pipeline

Reads Meta Ad Library Dataset IDs, Run IDs, or DTC landing URLs from **Google Sheets**, runs **4-layer 110+ tech stack detection + live 404/OOS/DMARC (Grade A–F) leak X-Ray + buyer-fit grading + 16-shard `watch_diff` triggers + zero-AI outreach copy**, protects your sender reputation by routing `cs_ticket_queue` / `manual_review_required` rows safely to a review tab, logs clean leads to Google Sheets, and alerts Slack `#agency-leads` + Gmail on `VIP_HOT` or fresh buying triggers.

**Actor URL:** https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/meta-ads-advertiser-leak-audit-email-enricher
**GitHub MCP & Kit:** https://github.com/wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
**Cost:** $4.50 / 1,000 unique deduplicated brands · **$0 on marketplaces, WAF skips, weekly repeats (`skip_seen`) & filtered misses** · 128–256 MB RAM · $0 proxy.

### 1. Advertiser Source (Google Sheets -> Audit Payload)

Create a spreadsheet with three tabs:
- **`AdvertiserTargets`**: columns `upstreamItems` (optional inline JSON array from a Meta Ad Library node, bounded <= 500 items for `LIMITED_PERMISSIONS`), `landingPageUrl` (optional), `agencyPreset` (`auto_best_fit`, `tiktok_google_ads`, `email_sms_retention`, `cro_landing_page`, `ugc_creative`, `deliverability_agency`), `dedupStoreName` (e.g. `meta-ads-watch-store`), `dedupMode` (`skip_seen` or `watch_diff`).
- **`AuditedAdvertisers`**: stores ready-to-send leads with `brandName`, `brandDomain`, `leadPriority`, `buyerFitTier`, `leakScore`, `expansionScore`, `primaryEmail`, `inboxType`, `deliverabilityGrade`, `detectedLeaksSummary`, `expansionOpportunitiesCsv`, `linkedinDecisionMakerSearchUrl`, `coldEmailSubject`, `coldEmailOpener`, `auditedAt`.
- **`ManualReviewOrCS`**: isolates `cs_ticket_queue` (Gorgias/Zendesk) and non-`ready` rows so you pivot to LinkedIn DM instead of hurting sender reputation.

### 2. 4-Layer 110+ Stack X-Ray & Inbox Safety Gate

1. Create a free [Apify account](https://apify.com) and generate an API token (`Settings -> API & Integrations`).
2. Create an n8n **Header Auth** credential (`Name`: `Authorization`, `Value`: `Bearer <token>`) and attach it to **Audit Meta Ads Advertisers via Apify**.
3. The **Safe for Email Outreach?** IF node checks `outreachStatus === 'ready'` AND non-empty `primaryEmail` AND `inboxType !== 'cs_ticket_queue'` AND `inboxType !== 'none'` AND `zeroBounceUnsafe !== true`, routing customer-support queues, no-email rows, quarantined emails, and manual-review rows safely to `ManualReviewOrCS` with a 1-click LinkedIn decision-maker link.

### 3. Priority Tiering, Sheet Sync & Multi-Channel Alerts

- **All outreach-ready DTC leads** are appended to `AuditedAdvertisers` in Google Sheets (CRM-ready).
- **VIP_HOT** (or `hasNewBuyingTrigger === true`) -> Slack `#agency-leads` + Gmail ready-to-send pitch brief.
- **WARM** & **NURTURE** (including Tier-2 expansion pitches) -> Slack `#agency-ops`.
